<style>
.teaching-container {
  max-width: 950px;

}

.teaching-header {

.teaching-header h2 {

.section-title::after {

.course-card {

}

.course-card:hover {

}

}

.badge-term {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #15803d;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
}

.badge-level {
  background: #f8fafc;

  font-weight: 500;

  border-radius: 6px;

}

.course-title {

.course-dept {

.course-desc {

}

.course-meta-grid {

.meta-item {

.exp-grid {

}

@media (max-width: 768px) {

}
</style>
